result.reason: The clause adds the required frequency, 30-day notice, business-hours, confidentiality, independence, and system-access protections. However, the cost shift remains triggered by any undefined “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than an underpayment exceeding 5%, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. It also adds non-interference and broader network/data restrictions beyond the stated requirement, and moving the cost provision before the operative audit clause creates an awkward, potentially ambiguous sequence.
